meta.name: li-plan
meta.description: Build the week on LinkedIn - what to post, when to post it, and who to engage with. Use when the user says "plan my week", "what should I post", "content calendar", "I have nothing to post about", or wants a posting schedule and an engagement list.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一周的 LinkedIn 内容排成计划,明确发什么、何时发、与谁互动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每周都为 LinkedIn 发什么、什么时候发而发愁
copy.tagline_en: Turn your week into a LinkedIn plan: what to post, when to post, and who to engage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you never know what or when to post on LinkedIn

howto.what: 它会为你排出一周 LinkedIn 计划:四条帖子的类型、主题、角度与发布时间,外加 10 人互动名单,结果写入 ~/.claude/linkedin/plan.md。它只出计划,不代为发布。
howto.when: 当你提到「plan my week」「content calendar」等说法,或你想知道该发什么、想要一份发布排期和互动名单时触发。建议每周同一天跑一次。

say.text: 帮我排这周的 LinkedIn 计划
say.note: 产出帖子槽位、时间与互动名单
它从你本周发生的事里找角度
按计划草拟周二的内容

howto.what_en: It builds your LinkedIn week: four posts with type, theme, angle, hook and posting time, plus a 10-person engagement list, written to ~/.claude/linkedin/plan.md. It only plans; nothing is scheduled or posted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "plan my week", "content calendar", or similar, or when you want a posting schedule and an engagement list. Run it once a week on the same day.

say_en.note: Gives post slots, times and engagement list

say_en.text: I have nothing to post about
say_en.note: It mines angles from your week
Drafts Tuesday's slot from the plan
